decisions.blue_ice: REJECT: large discrete shard/facet forms dominate instead of subtle close-scale continuous ice variation.
decisions.frosted_stone: REJECT: explicit snowflake-shaped motifs read as discrete decorative symbols rather than fine frost grain.
decisions.frozen_soil: PASS: edge-to-edge dark compacted soil with fine pale frost speckling; remains readable at 48px.
decisions.archive_stone: REJECT: large broken polygon slab boundaries dominate instead of smooth pale dressed-stone grain.
decisions.pale_timber: PASS: edge-to-edge pale timber grain with cool weathering and no scene/object composition.
decisions.crystal_stone: REJECT: large paving-like polygon facets/joints dominate instead of dense small-scale crystalline mineral facets.
decisions.cold_gravel: PASS: continuous small-scale frost-gray/pale-blue gravel aggregate with no focal object or scene composition.
